question.Q2_descriptive: On the S6 rehearsal decisions, how much do ESS, rho and PA-weight quantiles, mean weights and the weight-shift bound of the registered pair (candidate tau 0.1 P3, identity c13cc989, vs SupportedBC) change when only the denominator pi_b_hat changes?
question.Q3_descriptive: Is B0 self-consistent on DEV (pitch-group totals; mean PA weight = 1) and does a candidate reduce the gap?
not_asked: OPE value, Delta or verdict under any pi_b_hat (requires rewards; out of scope)

B1.shrinkage: p_l(a|k_l) = (n_l(a,k_l) + alpha_l * p_{l-1}(a|k_{l-1})) / (n_l(k_l) + alpha_l); zero outside R_j, renormalized inside at every level
B1.b0_as_special_case: alpha_pitcher 0, alpha_side inf, alpha_count inf, alpha_prev 20, deeper inf

search.basis: cheap, reduces order dependence; larger alpha = smoother

B2.pitcher_identity: TRAIN-only out-of-fold target encoding (18 B0-recipe probabilities; TRAIN rows from VectorBC fit on the other 4 TRAIN game folds, other splits from the registered BC_P) + log1p TRAIN volume; no raw categorical pitcher id (high cardinality, unknown pitchers)

vector_scaling.form: p proportional to exp(a_c * log p_c + b_c) inside R_j, a_c > 0

selection.rule: 5-fold game-grouped CV inside the temperature split; choose vector only if its mean CV NLL is lower than temperature's by >= 0.0005, else temperature; refit the chosen method on the whole split
selection.basis: do not spend 36 parameters on a near-zero gain; vector+Platt was NOT_CANDIDATE in the WS outcome line (docs/experiments.md:263)

calibration.fallback: vector optimizer fails (no convergence or a non-finite value) -> temperature, recorded; temperature optimizer also fails -> that candidate is CALIBRATION_FAILED (not eligible; its uncalibrated probabilities stay descriptive); a B0-T temperature failure leaves the B0-T descriptive entry empty
calibration.excluded: structured matrix scaling (arXiv 2511.03685): first-place claim not verifiable from the abstract; too many parameters for ~2 weeks of calibration rows (judgement)
calibration.optimizer: temperature: scipy minimize_scalar bounded [0.5, 2.5], default xatol; vector: scipy L-BFGS-B with the analytic gradient, default options, init a = 1/T, b = 0
calibration.failure_definition: failure = optimizer not successful or non-finite objective/parameters

cross_fitting.rule: whenever pi_b_hat is fit on the logs it evaluates, use game-fold cross-fitting and out-of-fold probabilities only

folds.unit: game (all pitches of a game in one fold)
folds.basis: D18 precedent K=5; each fit uses 80% of the window; salted hash instead of game_pk % K (independent of game numbering, as M-1)

cross_fitting.no_fold_specific_tuning: alpha, rounds and calibration fixed from the TRAIN-only fits
cross_fitting.primary_needs_none: A3 primary fits on TRAIN and scores DEV (no overlap) - the same shape as a 2027 out-of-time use
cross_fitting.xf_arms: B0-XF and B1-XF only (mandatory descriptive; Song D186 5-①, B2-XF not run): fit on TRAIN plus the other 4 DEV folds, predict DEV fold k; support redefined from the same rows; fitted in the separate xf-fit stage after freeze-primary and s6-integrity, recipe fixed at registration, deterministic; DEV pitch-type labels used for fitting are recorded in the exposure ledger; as-of violation acceptable only for OPE nuisance cross-fitting, never for the service
cross_fitting.xf_comparison: paired XF-minus-B0 NLL only on the original B0 S_in rows (the primary comparison rows); S_off rows to which XF gives mass ('rescued' new codes) are reported separately as the rescued share and their XF NLL (no paired comparison, B0 gives them probability 0)

seeds.calibration_cv_note: cv_folds (ported from experiments/ws_seq/calibrate_logits.py:324) needs a seed; the registered bootstrap seed 20260924 is reused

metrics.dev_metric_definition: a DEV metric is any value of metrics, positivity, self_consistency or ope_weight_diagnostics computed on DEV or S6 rows: candidate and descriptive-arm NLL, Brier, ECE, P1, accuracy and strata, SC1-SC3, new-denominator weight diagnostics and E5; the registered fixed-B0 integrity checks of s6-integrity (S6 identity, R1b, R2) are not DEV metrics
guards: top-label ECE10 (10 equal-width bins, matrix_metrics.py:33-51 definition, new 18-class function)
secondary: top-1 accuracy (descriptive only, never a decision input)
metrics.paired_inference: candidate minus B0, whole-game bootstrap 10,000 draws, seed 20260924, null-centered one-sided p (matrix_metrics.py:77-121 convention); ECE difference recomputed exactly per replicate from per-game bin sufficient statistics
strata_descriptive: pitcher TRAIN volume low/middle/high on P and zero (TRAIN0) on P_plus (q25/q75, matrix_panel.py:91-94, :149)

positivity.structural: S_off share overall and by volume (same for all candidates because support is fixed; reported only)

P1.definition: share of S_in with pi_b_hat(a_t|H_t) < threshold
P1.basis: below 0.1% one pitch costs >= 6.9 nats and its rho can exceed 1,000 x the target probability

positivity.why_not_count_structural_violations: a probability floor or full-vocabulary softmax removes zeros without creating identification (prereg probability_floor_creates_positivity false, :401); fixed support keeps the L1-R accounting comparable

self_consistency.SC1_pitch_group_totals: on all P (incl. S_off): observed share minus predicted share for groups fastball {FF, SI, FC, FA}, breaking {SL, ST, CU, KC, SV, CS}, offspeed {CH, FS, FO, SC}, other {KN, EP, PO, UN} and per code; overall, by volume and by count (the logging policy's own value under an action-only pseudo-reward vs the empirical mean, same pitch weighting)
self_consistency.SC2_mean_weight: on S6 E0: mean PA-end weight W_T (ope_weight_diagnostics.weights) and mean per-decision rho for candidate and reference; expectation 1 under a correct pi_b_hat (D18 diagnostic); game bootstrap CI

SC3_small_probability_ratio.statistic: observed / expected over all (decision, code) pairs per predicted-probability bin
SC3_small_probability_ratio.basis: dense bins where small probabilities inflate rho

ope_weight_diagnostics.e0_reconstruction: first-row pre-decision fields and frozen TRAIN artifacts only, PolicyRuntime.start_population rule (policy_runtime.py:340-360)

integrity_gates.stage: s6-integrity, before xf-fit and score-dev (code.stages); any failure -> FAILED_INTEGRITY, no later stage
integrity_gates.S6_identity: ledger and manifest sha256 and every runtime_sha256 equal the registration pins (data.s6_ledger), checked first; R1b and R2 are content checks, not identity
integrity_gates.R1b: VectorBC reproduces every ledger logging vector, max abs diff <= 1e-12

R2.rule: ESS of B0 weights recomputed from the ledger equals results/ML-POLICY-VAL-v1-S6-v3.json ess_all_e0 within relative 1e-9

ope_weight_diagnostics.reweighting: SUPPORTED rows: rho_t = pi(a_t) / pi_b_hat_new(a_t); OUTSIDE_POLICY_SUPPORT and LOGGING_POSITIVITY rows: rho_t = 0 for any denominator

weights.residual: W_t = prod_{s<=t} rho_s, the product through the current action (the affine recursion of policy_estimator.py:142-157 unrolled)
weights.pa_end: W_end = the affine slope weight_<policy>: for a complete PA the product through the last decision; a rho of 0 stops the prefix product at 0; a PA refused or censored at node k for a non-positivity reason keeps prod_{s<k} rho_s (policy_estimator.py:259); a positivity refusal closes at node k with rho_k = 0 (:256-258); used for ESS, PA-weight quantiles and SC2 (L1-R rule, :138-157, :255-270)

reported: PA and game ESS of both policies over all E0
candidate/reference ESS ratio (S3b threshold 0.5 for reference)
per-decision rho q50/q90/q99/max and share rho > 10
PA-end weight W_T quantiles and share W_T > 10
weight shift D = mean over PAs of sum_t |W_t_new - W_t_B0| over the residual weights, per policy and paired

large_weight_threshold.basis: one pitch or PA counts like ten

ope_weight_diagnostics.weight_shift_interpretation: DR PA value V_0 = v_0 + sum_t W_t (y_t - q_t(a_t)) with W_t the residual weight, y_t the next decision's v or the end value, and v, q, y in [0,1] so |y_t - q_t| <= 1; v_0 and q do not depend on the denominator, so a denominator swap changes V_0 (and each L1-R bound endpoint) by at most sum_t |dW_t| (conservative bound). D_paired < MEI 0.001 -> only: the fixed empirical mean contrast on these S6 games (point value and each bound endpoint) changes by less than 0.001 WE/PA under that bounded-residual assumption; it does NOT guarantee unchanged CI-based verdicts or ESS gates (configs/MLB-2026-OPE-PREREG-DRAFT-v1.json:800-828). Otherwise 'may change' only (actual bias = pi_b_hat error x Q error, unknown without rewards)
ope_weight_diagnostics.decision_use: E5 usability only; everything else descriptive

E1_nll_superiority.rule: dNLL = NLL_c - NLL_B0 <= -0.005 AND CI95 upper < 0 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p (family = the candidates run: B1 and B2) <= 0.05
E1_nll_superiority.approved_by: Song D186 4-① (docs/decisions.md:325), as drafted; fixed before any DEV metric
E1_nll_superiority.basis: ~7% of the measured BC-frequency gap (Cpanel DEV -0.071, docs/reports/ML-matrix-execution-2026-09-24.md:324-326); smallest gain worth a new nuisance registration

E2_ece_noninferiority.basis: ECE-difference CI half-widths 0.0016-0.0029 on 80,584 rows in EXP-WS-CAL-001 (C1 0.0021994, C2 0.0028627, C3 0.00160005; arithmetic on the interval endpoints in docs/experiments.md:263); DEV is larger

E3_positivity_noninferiority.basis: more than one extra near-zero decision per 2,000 lengthens the weight tail
